physicalNotes: Radius 0.57364716 Jupiter radii from Libby-Roberts et al. 2023 (2023AJ....165..249L), via the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2023AJ....165..249L/abstract): 41,011.2 km at 71,492 km per Jupiter radius.
